sourceNotes: The app is an Explore San Diego tourism experience with visible place data and view/state transitions.
Focus on current map extent grounding, source selection, renderer changes, and correction handling.

cases.title: Restaurant filtering and representation changes
cases.intent: Test whether the assistant can use the restaurant data source, refine filters, and change presentation without changing meaning.
turns: Show me restaurants in this app, just the names to start.
Only keep ones that sound like cafes or coffee places.
Show their details now, including address and website if available.
Put them on the map but don't switch to a different data source.
Actually compare them as a table, and don't invent missing websites.
cases.expectedBehavior: The assistant should stay on the relevant place dataset, refine the same result set, choose suitable renderers, and avoid implying missing fields are populated.
watchFor: Switches to a different layer or generic web behavior
Renderer changes silently alter the result set
Uses the wrong place context or wording

cases.title: Fun places map state and correction flow
cases.intent: Probe current map area grounding, correction handling, and honest limitations for fun places without repeating description-field issues.
turns: Which fun places are in the current map area?
Pick two that are parks or outdoor places if any exist.
Zoom to those two and summarize what they are.
No, keep the full current map extent and just select them if selection is supported.
Now clear that selection or explain if selection is not available.
cases.expectedBehavior: The assistant should ground itself to the current map extent, preserve or change app state according to the user's correction, and clearly separate zooming, filtering, and selection.
watchFor: Cannot distinguish zoom, filter, and selection
Leaves stale map state after correction
Claims selection cleared when no selection capability exists
